extensions.gridResize: Grip: 5px strip straddling a header's right edge, sand on hover and while dragging. Click widens 16px, Shift+click narrows 16px, double-click resets; Alt+Left/Right on a focused header steps 16px. Widths clamp to 64-960px. The grip is a separator named "Resize <column>", apart from the header's name.
extensions.apiReference: Scalar is themed onto the lagoon by @chelabase/lagoon/scalar.css, scoped to .lagoon-scalar. Surfaces ink/deep/channel, text chalk/chalk-dim, accent and button sand (ink text), borders --input (3:1), shadows replaced by a hairline. Method colours are their own small set, the one carve-out from One Meaning: each method has its own hue. POST and 2xx are seafoam (yes); DELETE, errors and alerts are coral (hazard). GET #9cc8ea, PUT #c4b6ec and PATCH #e3d58c are method-only tones (--method-get/put/patch, in the package's tokens.css); Scalar also uses PATCH's for 3xx and PUT's for required. OPTIONS, HEAD and TRACE are chalk-dim. Each is at least 5.4:1 on ink, deep and channel and on its 10% badge tint. Sand never marks a method or status; palm stays reserved. Code samples default to JavaScript / Axios.
openGaps: Phone width is not designed: a later pass gives the rail a drawer and the header its own menu trigger.
Buttons, dialogs and fields keep inherited shapes (8px radius) until the lagoon plates pass.
The shared button's focus is still the shadcn glow (ring-3 ring/50); the Primary Button sample shows the target 2px sand outline, not what ships.

narrative.northStar: The Tool Frame in Lagoon Water
narrative.overview:
Studio is a dark tool that recedes. One deep-water rail and an ink header, separated only by hairlines, frame a page body where developers work for long stretches. The lagoon world shows in precise details rather than in decoration: chalk text, pastel colours that each carry one meaning, square-cut chrome, and a brand that speaks once, as the claw wordmark and a sand "you are here" mark.

Density is calm and even: 36px rows, 18px line icons, a 14px UI face built for legibility. There are no depth bands, chart drawings or neat-line ticks in the app chrome. The confirmed rejections are a grey or green SaaS sidebar with glowing active pills, tinted cards and icon tiles; neon glow; purple SaaS; cream-and-terracotta editorial; and anything taken from Supabase's look, menu tree or wording.

Data surfaces keep structure and data on one plane: a table's columns stay in sight as a typed strip over its rows, and every change to them is staged, shown as exact SQL with its dry-run line, and applied once from one right panel.

The shell is desktop first. Phone-width behaviour is an open gap, not a rule (see Layout).
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default: `color-scheme: dark` on `:root`, lagoon ink ground everywhere, auth pages included.
Sand is the only action, selection and pending colour; coral means hazard; seafoam means yes.
Hairlines, not fills or shadows, separate regions; data grids add zebra rows and a hairline on every column edge.
Shell chrome is square-cut; focus is a square 2px sand outline.
Spectral appears only in the wordmark.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every pastel has one job: sand acts, selects and marks what is pending; coral warns; seafoam affirms. A pastel is never used as decoration or as a second accent.

rules.name: The Sand Never Warns Rule
rules.body: A warning, a risk or a failure is coral (an outlined coral square for a warning, a solid one for an error, a coral border around a box that needs attention). Sand on a staged change means "yours, not applied yet", never "careful".

rules.name: The Sand Is Here Rule
rules.body: The current location is marked by a 2px sand bar on the rail's edge plus chalk text, never by a filled or glowing pill.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Spectral is the wordmark and nothing else. Headings, labels and buttons stay in Atkinson.

rules.name: The Mono Identifier Rule
rules.body: Anything Postgres names (tables, columns, types, SQL, cell values) is set in JetBrains Mono; everything the UI says about it is Atkinson.

rules.name: The One Panel Rule
rules.body: A surface has at most one right panel, with one collapse control in its heading row and one 48px strip when collapsed. A second view replaces the first; it never stacks beside it.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface that sits above another gets a deep-water fill and a strong hairline. It never gets a drop shadow or glow.

dos: **Do** mark the current section with a 2px sand edge-mark and chalk text.
**Do** draw every focus state as a 2px square sand outline with no shadow.
**Do** separate surfaces with hairlines: chalk 16% for dividers, 34% for overlay and popup edges, 40% for control borders.
**Do** keep popups, menus and tooltips on deep water with a strong hairline.
**Do** set UI in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at 14px and icons as lucide line icons at 18px, stroke 1.5.
**Do** use a dashed outline only to mean "not there yet": not built (a rail placeholder) or not applied (a pending column).
**Do** make width changes 200ms on `ease-lagoon`, instant under reduced motion.
**Do** give data grids zebra rows (chalk 4.5%) and a hairline on every column edge and row.
**Do** keep a table's columns in sight as a typed strip over its grid, each chip over its column, with short type names.
**Do** give every drag a click and a keyboard alternative (the resize grip: click, Shift+click, double-click, Alt+arrows).
**Do** use the themed square checkbox and, inside panels, the `tab` segmented radio.
**Do** keep one sand-filled button per panel, popover or dialog: its commit.
**Do** state a dry-run result in one line: outcome, lock, rewrite.
**Do** use the 11px micro step only for gutter numbers, chips and tags.
donts: **Don't** use glowing or filled active pills, tinted cards or icon tiles in the chrome.
**Don't** add drop shadows or glows to shell surfaces, overlays included.
**Don't** use a pastel for anything but its one meaning; never a second accent beside sand.
**Don't** use sand to warn; warnings and risks are coral.
**Don't** open a second right panel or give a panel two collapse controls.
**Don't** ship browser-default checkboxes or a sand-filled segment inside a panel.
**Don't** take Supabase's look, menu tree or wording.
**Don't** colour UI with the claw mark's shell tones.
